providers.sourceAndCi: GitHub Free; container images built by GitHub Actions and stored in GHCR by digest
providers.pwaAndCdn: Azure Static Web Apps (Free) for the vendor, partner and admin static exports; the customer PWA and its same-origin BFF run as a container on the Azure VM behind Caddy
providers.compute: Azure VM (Azure for Students) running podman compose: API, worker, Valkey, Caddy, customer PWA
providers.queue: Valkey container on the Azure VM
providers.ingress: Caddy on the VM with Let's Encrypt certificates for the two cloudapp.azure.com DNS labels
providers.malwareScanning: ClamAV on the Azure VM (deferred until an adapter exists)

credentialPolicy: Provider credentials are stored only in provider secret stores, the company password manager and the VM's uncommitted release.env, and are never committed.

supersededTargets.objectStorage: Cloudflare R2, superseded by D-15 which approves Supabase Storage; the adapter is implemented, no bucket is provisioned
supersededTargets.pwaAndCdn: Cloudflare Pages for all four PWAs (D-12) and Workers/OpenNext for the customer PWA (D-15), superseded by D-16 which hosts the static shells on Azure Static Web Apps and the customer PWA as a container on the VM
supersededTargets.compute: OCI Always Free with a Cloudflare Tunnel, superseded by D-16 (Azure for Students) because OCI Free Tier requires payment-card verification and the student offer does not
supersededTargets.queue: Valkey on OCI, superseded by D-16
